items.note: Every New Capabilities bullet must name a kebab-case capability path (segments separated by '/'). Whether the path follows the project's existing spec organization is a judgment call and is not checked.

sources.quote: Use kebab-case for path segments you introduce (e.g., user-auth or identity/user-auth) that follow the project's existing spec organization. ... - `<capability-path>`: <brief description of what this capability covers>

items.downgrade_reason: The spec artifact also covers delta specs for Modified Capabilities, whose existing paths may predate the kebab-case rule, so the rule does not fit every delta path.
items.note: Delta spec directories created for new capabilities should use kebab-case path segments.

sources.quote: Use kebab-case for path segments you introduce (e.g., user-auth or identity/user-auth) that follow the project's existing spec organization. Each creates specs/<capability-path>/spec.md.

items.note: Each Modified Capabilities path should equal an existing openspec/specs/<path> directory at BASE_SHA. The base_paths fact lists files (…/spec.md), not capability paths, and no selector maps between the two forms, so this check cannot be expressed.

sources.quote: Existing capabilities whose REQUIREMENTS are changing (not just implementation). ... Use the exact existing path under openspec/specs/.

items.note: Conditional rule: when the proposal lists no new or modified capabilities, the change's .openspec.yaml must contain skip_specs: true. .openspec.yaml is not a declared artifact, so no kind or predicate can read its contents.

sources.quote: A change with no capabilities at all (pure refactor, tooling, docs) must set `skip_specs: true` in its .openspec.yaml - openspec validate rejects a zero-delta change without that marker.

unitemized.reason: This is a permission, not a requirement: Modified Capabilities may be left empty when no requirements change. The compiled template skeleton already covers the section, and no observable condition (beyond judging whether requirements changed) ties the empty value to something the run can show.
